verdicts.label: MISLEADING
verdicts.what_is_true_en: While there were widespread celebrations in India for the Chandrayaan-3 moon landing in August 2023, some images shared online to show this event are actually from the 2014 Mars Orbiter Mission (Mangalyaan) success.
verdicts.reasoning_en: The evidence confirms that India's Chandrayaan-3 mission did successfully land on the moon on August 23, 2023, leading to widespread celebrations (ws-3, ws-2). However, a TIER_1 fact-check (ws-6) reports that some images circulating online, purportedly showing these celebrations, are actually from the 2014 Mars Orbiter Mission (Mangalyaan). The claim is therefore misleading because it uses an old image to represent a recent event.
